data.name: Mauj
data.gender_notes: Mauj is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic context, Mauj signifies a wave or current in the sea of life, reminding us of the constant changes and movements in our existence. It is also mentioned in the Quran as a metaphor for Allah's power and control over His creation. The name Mauj carries the meaning “Wave, current” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mauj usually hope their child will grow to embody wave, current and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ebb and flow of life, inviting us to be adaptable and resilient in the face of change.
data.etymology: Mauj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wave, current.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mauj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
